description: Structured JSON logging with request middleware and error handling for backend services.

architecture: createLogger(service) → tagged Logger instance with .withRequestId() for child loggers
requestLogger middleware → attaches logger + requestId to request context, logs method/path/status/duration on response end
errorHandler middleware → catches errors, logs stack at error level, returns sanitized JSON response in production

environmentBehavior.production: JSON lines to stdout/stderr, debug level suppressed, error messages sanitized
